name: Simone Unger
headline: Manager Strategic Business Development & Business Partnerships
summary: Open-minded, solution-oriented and energetic professional with academic background in business administration and technology management. Experienced in strategy development, communication and implementation; portfolio management; business development (partnerships and new business models). Track record of successful M&A projects including post-merger integration management. Demonstrated skillset in leading cross-discipline and multicultural project teams. Broad functional understanding through background in business consulting (e.g. R&D, operations, quality). International work experience in several countries.

AUMOVIO – ready for the automotive transition 

We are the Adaptive Powerhouse for Future Mobility, making it safe, exciting, connected, and autonomous. 

To achieve this goal, we offer innovative hardware and software, modern mobility solutions, and a wide range of mobility services. 

We act in the here and now while thinking far ahead. We are reliable, no matter what, utterly focused, and passionate team players.  

With nearly 93,000 employees (as of December 31, 2024), we generated revenue of almost EUR 20 billion in the business year 2024.  

We have more than 100 locations globally, with headquarters in Frankfurt, Germany.  
 
Inspired by Future. Driven by Technology.
